# Gaps between Chapter 28's tooling and the compiler that the tools area's
# targets (FuzzFormat, FuzzFix, FuzzEditor, FuzzIncremental) found. A crash
# is keyed crash:<function that panicked>; its minimal reproduction
# is also listed by corpus file, so that it fails as XPASS once fixed.
# <target> <key> <owner> <what is missing, with the decision it breaks>
FuzzEditor crash:ls.getContainingArgumentInfo compiler textDocument/signatureHelp at the closing brace of `error E { a: string }` panics "Debug failure. Not a subspan. Child: KindPropertySignature, parent: KindTypeLiteral": the type literal an error declaration synthesizes does not span its members (Chapter 28, The editor, D32)
FuzzEditor corpus:signature-help-error-declaration compiler the minimal reproduction of crash:ls.getContainingArgumentInfo
FuzzEditor crash:ast.SourceFile.GetOrCreateToken compiler textDocument/completion (and signature help) inside the keyword of `service Users { … }` panics "Token cache mismatch: KindClassKeyword != KindIdentifier" in astnav.FindPrecedingToken: the class a service declaration synthesizes caches a class keyword token at the identifier's position (Chapter 28, The editor, D32, D78)
FuzzEditor corpus:completion-service-keyword compiler the minimal reproduction of crash:ast.SourceFile.GetOrCreateToken
FuzzEditor editor:parse:Convert-to-a-pipe compiler the refactor "Convert to a pipe" (D245) writes `{ a: 1 } |> String(%) |> Console.log(%)` for the statement `Console.log(String({ a: 1 }))`: an object literal at the start of a statement parses as a block, so the result is a syntax error; every automatic change keeps the program (Chapter 28, Rewrites keep meaning, D372)
FuzzEditor corpus:convert-to-pipe-object-literal compiler the minimal reproduction of editor:parse:Convert-to-a-pipe
FuzzEditor editor:quickfix-error:EK4832:EK2109 compiler the quick fix of EK4832 is offered for `Schema.Struct({ a: Missing.fields.a })`, a field the checker cannot resolve, and writes `schema S { a: Missing.fields.a }`, which adds EK2109; a fix is offered only where the checker proves it keeps the program (Chapter 28, Rewrites keep meaning, D372, D286)
FuzzEditor corpus:schema-fix-unresolved-field compiler the minimal reproduction of editor:quickfix-error:EK4832:EK2109
FuzzFormat corpus:parser-hang-layer-close-paren compiler hang: the parser never finishes `layer e{)` (or `layer e{]`): parseLayerDeclaration calls parseStatement on a token it never consumes, so vibelang, the formatter and the language server hang on such a file
FuzzFormat feature:layer-declaration compiler hang: the parser loops on a stray `)` or `]` in a `layer` declaration's body (corpus parser-hang-layer-close-paren), so campaigns leave layer declarations out
FuzzFix feature:layer-declaration compiler hang: the parser loops on a stray `)` or `]` in a `layer` declaration's body (FuzzFormat corpus parser-hang-layer-close-paren)
FuzzEditor feature:layer-declaration compiler hang: the parser loops on a stray `)` or `]` in a `layer` declaration's body (FuzzFormat corpus parser-hang-layer-close-paren)
FuzzIncremental feature:layer-declaration compiler hang: the parser loops on a stray `)` or `]` in a `layer` declaration's body (FuzzFormat corpus parser-hang-layer-close-paren)
FuzzEditor editor:quickfix-error:EK4835:EK9201+TS2339+TS2349 compiler the quick fix of EK4835 for `fail() |> Effect.catchTag(%, "A", (e) => "a")` writes `(%() catch (e) => match (e) { … })`, calling the pipe's topic, a value since D325, which adds TS2349, TS2339 and EK9201; a quick fix keeps the program and adds no error (Chapter 28, Rewrites keep meaning, D372, D289)
FuzzEditor corpus:catch-fix-pipe-topic compiler the minimal reproduction of editor:quickfix-error:EK4835:EK9201+TS2339+TS2349
FuzzFormat format:refusal:ModuleDeclaration compiler D276: the formatter refuses the syntax-error-free parser input `module {}` because its projection requires a module name (corpus refusal-unnamed-module)
FuzzFormat corpus:refusal-unnamed-module compiler D276: the formatter refuses the syntax-error-free parser input `module {}` because its projection requires a module name
FuzzEditor editor:empty:hover:Block<Block<LabeledStatement compiler D61/D77: hover returns no contents for a declared function called inside a retired select arm even though the document parses (corpus hover-retired-select)
FuzzEditor corpus:hover-retired-select compiler D61/D77: hover returns no contents for a declared function called inside a retired select arm even though the document parses
FuzzFix fix:unapplied:EK2112:no-fix compiler Chapter 28 (D216): EK2112 marks a retired spelling "with a quick fix", but `catch (e: Error)` draws it with no quick fix and no explanation, and --fix leaves it (case decl-catch-untagged.fail, corpus typed-catch-error-class)
FuzzFix corpus:typed-catch-error-class compiler Chapter 28 (D216): the minimal reproduction of fix:unapplied:EK2112
FuzzFormat format:refusal:ClassDeclaration:expected-for-property-initializer compiler D276: the formatter refuses `service S {\n  a: string,\n}`, whose field comma the parser accepts and the checker reports as EK1013, because the comma does not parse in the TypeScript projection; an `abstract error` body refuses the same way. Chapter 28 permits a refusal only when the formatted text would not parse to the same tree, and does not call EK1013 a syntax error as it does EK1022 (if it should, the oracle's syntax-error check must learn EK1013 instead)
FuzzFormat corpus:refusal-service-field-comma compiler D276: the minimal reproduction of format:refusal:ClassDeclaration:expected-for-property-initializer
FuzzEditor editor:quickfix-error:EK4802:TS2349 compiler the quick fix "Call it to run it" of EK4802 adds TS2349 (This expression is not callable): for `const chosen = code > 0 ? Effect.void : listFlows; return chosen` it writes `return chosen()`, a call of a union with an Effect value among its members, and for `const a = Effect.suspend(() => () => 1); return a()` it writes `(() => 1)()`, after which `a()` is not callable; a quick fix is offered only where the checker proves it keeps the program and adds no error (Chapter 28, Rewrites keep meaning, D372, D291)
FuzzEditor corpus:call-fix-union-member compiler the minimal reproduction of editor:quickfix-error:EK4802:TS2349 (a returned union of an Effect value and a program)
FuzzEditor corpus:call-fix-suspend-callback compiler the minimal reproduction of editor:quickfix-error:EK4802:TS2349 (a program returned from an Effect.suspend callback)
FuzzEditor editor:quickfix-error:EK4834:EK2116 compiler the quick fix of EK4834 writes `return 1` for `function work() { return Effect.succeed(1) }`, and the compiler then reports EK2116 at a caller that returns a program on another path; Chapter 28 retires EK2116 ("Retired codes keep their numbers unused: ... EK2115 and EK2116, since annotations no longer make factories (D323)"), yet the compiler still reports it and EK2115, as the acceptance cases expect; deciding whether to delete both checks belongs to D323
FuzzEditor editor:quickfix-error:EK2113:TS2345 compiler the quick fix "Match on exit(…)" of EK2113 rewrites `try { return 0 } catch (cause: Cause) { return 1 }` as `return match (exit(0)) { … }`, and exit takes an Effect, so it adds TS2345 for a try block that returns a plain value; a quick fix keeps the program and adds no error (Chapter 28, Rewrites keep meaning, D372, D217). --fix refuses the same rewrite at the try's line, not the diagnostic's, so FuzzFix reports the input as fix:unapplied:EK2113:offered
FuzzEditor corpus:cause-fix-plain-value compiler the minimal reproduction of editor:quickfix-error:EK2113:TS2345
FuzzFix fix:unapplied:EK2113:no-fix compiler Chapter 28 says EK2113 marks a retired spelling "with a quick fix", and the registry's fix rewrites only `try { return X } catch (c: Cause) { return Y }`: a Cause clause after a try block that throws, or followed by another clause, draws EK2113 with no quick fix and no explanation, and --fix leaves it; a fix or a note saying what a rewrite would change is missing (Chapter 28, Diagnostics and Rewrites keep meaning, D217, D372)
FuzzFix corpus:cause-catch-throw-body compiler the minimal reproduction of fix:unapplied:EK2113:no-fix
FuzzEditor  editor:quickfix-error:EK9100*  superseded  VIP-1: a keyword, effect or async, decides a function's form, so EK9100's annotation quick fix for an inferred form is obsolete
FuzzFormat format:emit:lost:EK4618 compiler D372 and decided detail 72a: for a file that parses, the formatter keeps its diagnostics and emitted JavaScript exactly, and meaning-changing rewrites are `vibelang --fix` quick fixes, but vip-core's formatter (3f873a15) rewrites the removed shorthand `async f()` and `effect f()` to `function` form, so formatting case ek4618-function-shorthand.fail drops its EK4618 error; lane d-tooling moves the rewrite to --fix (fmt-rewrites-shorthand)
FuzzEditor feature:compiler-gap-vip19 compiler  VIP-19: the specification example of `for concurrent (let x of (read = (): number => x, [1]))`, marked `// compiler-gap: pending VIP-19, VIP-20`, gets no completion at the head's declared `x` (editor:empty:completion, seed#36 on 2756e4a2); its head scope is not built yet; lane core-fortry
FuzzEditor feature:compiler-gap-vip20 compiler  VIP-20: the specification example of `for concurrent (let x of (read = (): number => x, [1]))`, marked `// compiler-gap: pending VIP-19, VIP-20`, gets no completion at the head's declared `x` (editor:empty:completion, seed#36 on 2756e4a2); its head scope is not built yet; lane core-fortry
